Tier ladder mirrors ui3 StProfileReferralRewardsTab TIERS (ReferralJourney/constants.ts). Fetched public, no auth, on 2026-06-23.
_notes: The live catalyrst-credits crate (catalyrst-credits/src/lib.rs) exposes /credits/seasons and /credits/users/{wallet}/progress, both auth-chain gated (signer_from), so the public SSR site cannot mint the signature and falls back to this fixture. There is no public referral-progress route on the crate yet; the referral state below is derived faithfully from the schemas REFERRAL metadata shape (tier/invitedUsers/rarity) and the ui3 TIERS ladder. The referrer profile is the Profile/lambdas Avatar shape (resolveReferrerProfile -> /lambdas/profiles/{address}). The referral attribution WRITE (binding the visitor session to this referrer) is SIMULATED in the route loader: it computes the attribution payload and emits the lp_invite_referrer_resolved event but performs no on-chain or backend write.

faqs.a: Decentraland is a community-driven virtual world where you can connect, explore, and create. Built on the Unity engine, Decentraland streams and renders a vast, continuous environment filled with diverse, user-generated content. As you explore this immersive landscape, you encounter new creations daily, from games and puzzles to scenes and artworks, all crafted by Decentraland's vibrant community of creators.

Download and install the client, create your account (a standard web3 wallet such as Metamask, or a Social account like Google, Discord, X, or Apple), customize your avatar, and explore. After a quick tutorial, Decentraland is yours to explore.

faqs.q: Do I need cryptocurrency or a digital wallet to use Decentraland?
faqs.a: You do not need to own cryptocurrency to enjoy Decentraland as it is free to use. If you sign in with a Social account, a digital wallet is created for you behind the scenes.

faqs.q: How does the invite reward work?
faqs.a: Share your referral link with friends. Invitees must be new to Decentraland and must jump in-world on 3 separate days to count toward your reward goals. As accepted invites stack up, you unlock exclusive wearables, emotes and badges along a 9-tier ladder, all the way to an IRL Swag Pack.
